issues.description: Exact cluster number for cortex immune cell subset clustering is not explicitly stated in the text; cluster inventory uses an inferred count of 4 based on described populations (microglia, perivascular macrophages, T cells, COVID-19-associated immune subpopulation).
Figure label 'PV' normalized to official gene symbol PVALB (parvalbumin).
Fig. 1e text extraction is partially garbled; PRLR and SLC26A3 new findings are inferred from cluster labels 'Endothelial PRLRhigh' and 'SLC26A3high Ependymal'.
'MThigh' in Fig. 1e is not a standard gene entity and was not treated as a marker.
CD68 is explicitly called a microglial activation marker but is used in immunohistochemistry for reactivity assessment/validation rather than for cell-type annotation; therefore judged context_only.
